run_mot_param_search: run a parameter search across tracker config values to evaluate MOTA, HOTA, and Identity metrics
run_mot_eval_with_detector: run MOT evaluation using a separate detector checkpoint file with the --detector flag
run_mot_eval_with_reid: run MOT evaluation using a separate reid checkpoint file with the --reid flag
get_search_params: recursively extract all list-valued config keys from a tracker config for parameter search
parse_args_mot_test: parse CLI arguments for config path, checkpoint, work dir, launcher, and cfg options
